svg.title: TCP repairs loss in an ordered byte stream
svg.desc: Two transport terminals with a replay holder and acknowledgement carriage. TCP transports an ordered byte stream. It does not preserve application message boundaries.
svg.text: TCP repairs loss in an ordered byte stream
Client and server exchange SYN, SYN-ACK, and ACK.
Sequence numbers identify byte positions; acknowledgements identify received
A missing segment prevents complete ordered delivery of the affected bytes.
